svg.title: Two texts through the dummy GPT
svg.desc: B = 2 examples · T = 4 positions · D = 768 coordinates · V = 50,257 tokens; Outside model · encode text, then stack token-ID rows / “Every effort moves you” and “Every day holds a” → IDs [2, 4]; Inside model · look up two independent embedding tables / Token IDs → [2, 4, 768]; position IDs [0, 1, 2, 3] → [4, 768]; Add token and position vectors, then apply embedding dropout / Broadcast position vectors across both examples → [2, 4, 768]; Twelve dummy blocks, then dummy normalization / All are identity operations here → still [2, 4, 768]; Vocabulary projection · 768 coordinates → 50,257 scores / out_head returns logits [2, 4, 50257]; Outside model · last-position scores for generation / logits[:, -1, :] has shape [2, 50257]; token selection comes later.
svg.text: Two texts through the dummy GPT
B = 2 examples · T = 4 positions · D = 768 coordinates · V = 50,257 tokens
Outside model · encode text, then stack token-ID rows
“Every effort moves you” and “Every day holds a” → IDs [2, 4]
Inside model · look up two independent embedding tables
Add token and position vectors, then apply embedding dropout
Broadcast position vectors across both examples → [2, 4, 768]
Twelve dummy blocks, then dummy normalization
All are identity operations here → still [2, 4, 768]
Outside model · last-position scores for generation
logits[:, -1, :] has shape [2, 50257]; token selection comes later.
